title: Ulla bar Chinena—or Chananyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sukkah 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.33a.4) and [36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.36a.2) and in [Nazir 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.51b.5), under the formula “Ulla b-Ch (ב״ח) taught.”[^1]

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=142) gives תני, “taught,” where the supplied text has הני. The three passages use the teaching formula. Sukkah 33a gives Chinena; Sukkah 36a and Nazir give Chanina, beside Hyman’s Chananyah. Compare [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2847&lang=en).
